'''RC-3T''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who belonged to the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] [[Draknus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], RC-1Z, along with [[RC-1Z]] and [[RC-2X]], helped Draknus to manage the [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] race track on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:PR" />

==Behind the scenes==
RC-3T was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:PR" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> RC-3T was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
